text:
Sofia: Quick capture from today's onboarding with Northpoint — two asks that are on their renewal checklist (renewal in ~5w): (1) a downloadable ledger-style report that links "feature" -> "route" -> token counts -> USD charges so FP&A can allocate spend to product owners, (2) a quiet-hours mode that suppresses non-actionable alerts and delivers a single digest at 3pm local.
Ethan: Can you paste their exact phrasing for the report? Need a quote for the product ticket.
Sofia: Quote from the CRO: 'We need something our finance team can drop into the books. A single CSV with feature tags and dollars, not ten screenshots.'
Leah: They also stressed the digest must be human-friendly (one line per alert) and include how to acknowledge. Otherwise PMs ignore the noise.
Ravi: Dev quick take: if we already have route->token aggregations, producing CSV + small mapping surface to attach a "feature_id" per route is ~10 dev days. Joining accurate USD requires pricing join and org-specific discounts lookup: add ~2-3w with QA. Digest + quiet-hours (org-scheduled, plus per-team thresholds) ~4-7 dev days.
AM-Ben: Flagging as renewal-impacting. If we can commit to an interim delivery (CSV with feature column blank for now) and offer them beta access to full cost mapping, that might keep the deal on track.
Sofia: They said they'd be willing to do beta testing and volunteered their FP&A to validate output. They also uploaded a sample Excel layout to the shared folder.
Ethan: Action items: (A) Ravi to confirm whether pricing join exists and give firm ETAs for interim vs full; (B) Sofia to attach the sample CSV layout and confirm beta participants; (C) AM-Ben to make sure AE mentions this in the renewal exec call. Check-in in 72h.
Ravi: I'll spike the pricing join tomorrow and post a short tech note with blockers. If join exists, interim (CSV w/ feature column blank) could ship in ~8 business days; full cost-mapped CSV ~3-4w.
Leah: For digest UX: propose 1) suppress low-severity pings during quiet-hours, 2) batched digest email with actionable links + ack button. I'll sketch a mock and post in this thread.
product-bot: Created PB-8199 "Northpoint: feature-attribution spend export + alert digest" tags=[cs, renewal-risk, telemetry].
AM-Ben: I'll add a renewal-risk flag and estimated impact to PB-8199 and notify the AE.
Sofia: Uploaded their sample CSV and a short note on who will beta-test (link). They want an interim commitment before the renewal conversation. :pray:
Ethan: Thanks all. Prioritize interim path unless Ravi surfaces blockers. We'll escalate if dates slip.
Sofia: Will DM any exec asks. Keeping this hot.
